name: EPSY 5420
title: Roles and Functions of School Psychologists
description: The roles and functions of school psychologists, including the development of the specialty, delivery models, assessment, and interventions. Addresses the provision of comprehensive and integrated school psychological services as outlined by the National Association of School Psychologists and the health service provider specialty of professional psychology of the American Psychological Association.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
